---
applyTo: "apps/mobile/**/*.dart"
---
# Flutter and Dart
- Use Flutter, Dart, and Riverpod; keep presentation, state, and domain responsibilities distinct.
- Preserve accessibility, localization readiness, and reliable behavior on supported mobile platforms.
- Use the Dart formatter and analyzer once the app is initialized; do not add packages without a clear need.
- Keep secrets and privileged business rules out of the client.
- Follow the V2.1 source specification when available and record unresolved decisions rather than guessing.
